description: This file defines a singly linked list data structure with operations to add, remove, retrieve size, and access elements by index. It includes internal node management and utility functions.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list implementation with basic list operations.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: An internal class representing a node in the linked list, holding data and reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.
